meta.title: Pre-Decision Questions, Verified Answers & Missing-Data Discovery Guide

questions.question: What are current benchmark Treasury & net-lease reinvestment yields as of Nov 2026?
questions.answer: 10Y Treasury Par Yield = 4.98% (Nov 10, 2026); Fed funds upper = 4.00%; Realty Income Q3 2026 initial weighted avg acquisition cash yield = 6.8% (down 50 bps from FY25's 7.3%, filed Nov 2, 2026).
questions.discovery_suggestion: Monitor U.S. Treasury Daily Yield Curve & Q4 2026 REIT earnings prior to any sale listing.

questions.question: How healthy is Jack in the Box Corp. entering late 2026?
questions.answer: Stabilizing cash flow ($61.2M Q3 EBITDA, +$27.9M 40-wk net earnings, $500M May 2031 ARD notes, Del Taco sold Dec 2025, Sep 21 Board/GreenWood agreement) offset by contracting footprint (2,115 stores vs 2,136 FY25; FY26 target ~2,100; -1.1% Q3 SSS; $901.3M equity deficit; dividends suspended).
questions.discovery_suggestion: Track Q4 FY2026 10-K (expected late Nov 2026) and store-closure lists.

questions.question: Is Central/County Los Angeles growing or shrinking in population and personal income?
questions.answer: Population is mildly declining (-0.8% City / -3.2% County 2020-2025; CA DOF P-2A projects LA County falling -1.77% from 9.81M in 2026 to 9.64M in 2040), while total consumer scale remains huge ($818.5B personal income #1 in US; City MHHI $81,939 / County $90,112; rent-burdened 57.3% City).
questions.discovery_suggestion: Pull 1-mile / 3-mile trade-area Census tract demographics once parcel address is entered privately.

questions.question: What is the local job growth, inflation, and transit/trade trajectory?
questions.answer: MSA nonfarm payrolls +0.5% YoY (6,282.1k) and LA County SA unemployment fell to 4.8% (Sep 2026) led by Health/Edu (+3.8% MSA) and Leisure/Hosp (+1.5% MSA) despite Information (-5.7%); Sep CPI +3.7%, ECI +3.9%, AB 1228 fast-food wage $20.00/hr; Port of LA hit record 1,042,652 TEUs (Sep 2026) & Metro D Line Sec. 1 opened May 8, 2026.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Evaluate parcel proximity to new Metro D Line stations and healthcare/university nodes.

questions.question: How do Central LA public schools (LAUSD) measure up on the latest 2026 data?
questions.answer: LAUSD (#1 CA district, 497,105 enrollment) achieved an 87.6% graduation rate on the newly posted 2026 CA School Dashboard (+1.1% YoY, Green), 58.0% College/Career prepared (+2.5%), though 86.9% SED and Math (-40.7 dfs) indicate mixed household purchasing power.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Check assigned elementary/high school ratings within Zillow/CDE School Directory for exact Central LA sub-neighborhood.

questions.question: What property tax, transfer tax, and federal/state capital gains rules govern a sale vs. hold?
questions.answer: Prop 13 caps assessment growth at <=2%/yr (vs 3.7% CPI); Measure ULA adds 4.0% (>$5.4M) or 5.5% (>=$10.9M) above 0.45% City + 0.11% County DTT = up to 6.06%; Federal LTCG 0/15/20% + 25% Sec. 1250 + 3.8% NIIT; CA taxes gains as ordinary up to 13.30% (Prop 3 leading 60.7% Yes to make permanent; Prop 43 losing 57.4% No); Sec. 1031 (45/180 days) defers income tax.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Verify closing date relative to July 1 annual ULA threshold CPI resets and Dec 11 election certification.

questions.question: What are the documented regional catastrophe base rates and recent loss magnitudes?
questions.answer: Jan 2025 Eaton & Palisades fires burned 37,469 acres, destroyed 16,251 structures, and cost $5.2B-$10.1B in lost output, triggering a $1.0B CDI FAIR Plan assessment; USGS estimates 60% M>=6.7 (3.01%/yr) and 46% M>=7.0 30-yr earthquake probabilities.
questions.discovery_suggestion: Use verified regional rates for portfolio reserve sizing, and run private parcel map checks (Q17-Q19).

questions.question: What is the exact executed contract base rent, percentage rent breakpoint, and NNN expense leakage?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Pull executed Lease + all Amendments, last 12 months rent ledger, and trailing 3-year CAM/tax/insurance reconciliation; verify if roof/structure/parking capital repairs fall on landlord.

questions.question: What is the exact expiration date within 2030-2035, how many renewal options remain, and is option rent fixed, CPI-linked, or FMV?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Build a critical-dates abstract from the original lease & option exercise notices; calendar tenant notice window deadlines (often 6-12 months prior) so options are never missed.

questions.question: Who is the actual tenant/guarantor on the lease—Jack in the Box Inc. corporate sublease or a local franchisee LLC?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Check Lease signature block, Landlord's Estoppel Certificate, and corporate/personal guaranty; request 3 years of franchisee P&L, store-level sales, and unit-level rent-to-sales ratio (benchmark healthy <=8%-9%).

questions.question: What is the owner's adjusted tax basis, accumulated depreciation, and entity structure?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Obtain acquisition settlement statement, Form 4562 / fixed-asset depreciation schedule, and K-1/entity operating agreement; engage CPA to compute exact Sec. 1250 + Fed + CA 13.3% taxable liability vs. 1031 carryover.

questions.question: Is there existing mortgage debt, and what are its maturity date, interest rate, and prepayment/defeasance penalties?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Request current lender payoff letter, promissory note prepayment schedule (yield maintenance/defeasance), and loan maturity vs. 2030-2035 lease expiration (lenders typically require lease term >= loan maturity + 3-5 yrs).

questions.question: What are the owner's net-worth concentration, liquidity needs, and succession/estate plan?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Assess privately with wealth advisor: what % of net worth sits in this single Central LA parcel, whether stepped-up basis at estate transfer alters 1031 vs. hold horizon, and family appetite for active re-tenanting.

questions.question: Does the parcel fall inside City of Los Angeles municipal limits (Measure ULA 4.45%-5.95%) or unincorporated LA County / neighboring city?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Enter APN privately into LA County Assessor Portal (assessor.lacounty.gov) or LA City ZIMAS (zimas.lacity.org) and verify the Tax Rate Area / jurisdiction on the latest property tax bill.

questions.question: What price and cap rate would institutional/1031 buyers pay today vs. with a 10-year or 15-year extension?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Order two confidential Broker Opinions of Value (BOVs) from active SoCal single-tenant QSR specialists plus a commercial MAI appraisal showing cap rate at remaining WALT vs. 10-yr/15-yr WALT and dark-store residual land value.

questions.question: Would the tenant/operator accept a confidential early Blend-and-Extend (10-15 yrs) and at what rent reset & TI allowance?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Approach tenant real-estate/franchisee quietly via net-lease advisor without listing publicly: compare site sales against JACK FY25 $1,874k AUV; check franchise expiration vs. lease expiration.

questions.question: What is the parcel's official CAL FIRE Fire Hazard Severity Zone (FHSZ) and Local Responsibility Area designation?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Enter parcel address privately into the live CAL FIRE OSFM FHSZ Viewer (linked in S28) and check LAFD / LACoFD 2025 LRA maps.

questions.question: What are the parcel's FEMA Flood Zone and CGS Alquist-Priolo Fault / Liquefaction / Landslide determinations?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Enter address privately into FEMA Flood Map Service Center (msc.fema.gov) and California Geological Survey EQ Zapp (conservation.ca.gov/cgs/geohazards/eq-zapp).

questions.question: What is the current commercial property, seismic, and loss-of-rent insurance cost, carrier rating, and renewal outlook?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Collect policy declarations page and 5-year loss runs from tenant (if tenant insures under NNN) plus landlord's contingent DIC/umbrella quote; test whether total insurance >1.5% of property value.

questions.question: What is the parcel's zoning, grandfathered drive-thru status, TOD tier (Metro D Line / SB-79), and physical condition?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Pull LA City ZIMAS Zoning & Specific Plan summary (check LAMC drive-thru CUP rules), measure distance to Metro stations, and order a Property Condition Assessment + Phase I Environmental Site Assessment (ESA).

questions.question: What current assessed value (Factored Base Year Value) and direct parcel assessments appear on the secured tax bill?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Download current secured property tax bill from ttc.lacounty.gov using parcel APN; quantify the landlord/tenant Prop 13 protection gap relative to current market value.

questions.question: What qualified §1031 replacement properties exist today (and at what real net yield vs. Realty Income's 6.8% benchmark)?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Pre-vet a Qualified Intermediary (QI) and review 6-8 live NNN/DST replacement offerings across diversified states/tenants before signing any purchase-and-sale contract (45-day ID clock starts at closing).

questions.question: Where will 10-Year Treasury yields and single-tenant QSR cap rates trade in 2030-2035?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Unknowable in advance; handled in Session P via ±150 bps exit cap sensitivity and stochastic rate shocks in the 15,000-trial Monte Carlo.

questions.question: Will a major LA earthquake (M>=6.7), urban wildfire, or regional downturn occur before lease expiry?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Handled via UCERF3 annualized hazard probability (3.01%/yr), wildfire/FAIR Plan insurance tail shocks, and maintaining 12-month liquidity reserves.

questions.question: Will California or Los Angeles amend Proposition 13 (split roll) or Measure ULA before exit?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Nov 2026 Prop 43 rejection preserves majority-vote local tax initiatives; monitor ballot filings every two-year cycle and test closing timing against annual July 1 ULA threshold CPI updates.

questions.question: Will Jack in the Box execute a successful turnaround under new Board/CEO leadership or shrink further in California?
questions.discovery_suggestion: Mitigate via tenant-default stress modeling, checking store unit sales vs. $1.874M AUV, and securing corporate/multi-unit guaranty before granting any lease extension.
